queries.query: Kong readinessProbe.httpGet.path changes from /status to /status/ready. What readiness prerequisites need review?
After the gateway rollout, traffic handling instances might never become healthy when the configuration manager runs elsewhere. Which migration note explains this?
Custom Kong plugins write local files but readOnlyRootFilesystem changes from false to true. What changed?
An extension needs to create temporary files inside a container whose filesystem has become immutable. Which migration note concerns that?
kube-state-metrics is being updated. Which listener serves the readiness healthcheck: the metrics endpoint or self telemetry?
Before upgrading external-secrets, which stored custom-resource API version has to be checked?

scope: Six author-defined queries over four public passages plus two synthetic distractors. Not held out, independent, representative or a security certification.
baseline: Unique highest count of shared lowercase alphanumeric/underscore tokens; ties are not a unique first-place match
scoring: V2: full-passage overlapping 512-token pair windows, stride 32, maximum window logit; prior non-windowed result retained separately
